title: A nuclear receptor PcHR96h regulates ABC transporters involved in spirodiclofen resistance in Panonychus citri.
authors: Li, Sichen; Yu, Shijiang; Yang, Qiqi; Huang, Zehao; Li, Yang; Wang, Mengxia; Huang, Meiyi; Fu, Shijun; Wu, Zhen; Liu, Liu; Pan, Qi; Zhang, Wei; Liu, Haoqiang; Cong, Lin; Ran, Chun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究核受体PcHR96h通过DAP-seq、EMSA和分子对接调控ABC转运蛋白参与杀螨剂抗性，涉及TF-DNA结合验证但以实验为主，AI/物理模拟方法较浅，属广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可迁移。
abstract: Transcription factors are known to regulate detoxification gene expression and contribute to resistance to insecticides and acaricides in arthropods. Our previous study revealed that the nuclear hormone receptor PcHR96h is associated with spirodiclofen resistance in Panonychus citri, but its regulatory mechanism remains unclear. Here, we used DAP-seq to identify genome-wide targets of PcHR96h and found that ABC transporter genes were significantly enriched. Dual-luciferase, yeast one-hybrid, and EMSA assays verified that PcHR96h directly binds to the promoters of PcABCA2 and PcABCB2. Functional validation via RNAi, subcellular localization, cytotoxicity tests, and molecular docking further confirmed that these two ABC transporters participate in spirodiclofen resistance. This study demonstrates that PcHR96h regulates specific ABC transporters involved in spirodiclofen resistance in P. citri, providing new insights into HR96-driven detoxification and acaricide resistance.
abstract_zh: 已知转录因子调控解毒基因表达，并参与节肢动物对杀虫剂和杀螨剂的抗性。我们先前的研究揭示，核激素受体PcHR96h与柑橘全爪螨（Panonychus citri）对螺螨酯的抗性相关，但其调控机制尚不清楚。本研究采用DAP-seq技术鉴定了PcHR96h的全基因组靶标，发现ABC转运蛋白基因显著富集。双荧光素酶、酵母单杂交和EMSA实验验证了PcHR96h直接结合PcABCA2和PcABCB2的启动子。通过RNAi、亚细胞定位、细胞毒性测试和分子对接的功能验证进一步确认，这两个ABC转运蛋白参与螺螨酯抗性。本研究证明，PcHR96h调控特定ABC转运蛋白参与柑橘全爪螨对螺螨酯的抗性，为HR96驱动的解毒和杀螨剂抗性提供了新见解。
